profile.headline: Software Engineer | Seeking Software Development Opportunities
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with a passion for problem-solving, learning, and creating things that make a real impact.

I've been given the opportunity to experience several sides of technology and develop valuable industry skills, from software testing and web development to product management. These roles have taught me that great technology isn’t only about writing good code, it’s about understanding the people using it, solving the right problems, and working well with others to turn ideas into something meaningful.

I’ve also had the opportunity to step into a leadership role as an Assistant Manager, where I gained experience leading a team, organizing events and programs, solving problems in a fast-paced environment, and building relationships with members of the community.

Having experience in both technical and people focused roles has helped me become a stronger communicator, teammate, and problem solver. I’m excited to bring those experiences back into the computing industry and continue growing as a software engineer.

Currently, I'm seeking opportunities in software development and related technology roles where I can contribute, continue learning, and take on new challenges.

positions.title: Assistant General Manager
positions.description:
Created a welcoming environment and maintained a positive experience for members through daily interaction and problem resolution.
Trained and led Member Specialists while coordinating daily responsibilities and ensuring club operations ran smoothly.
Organized and supported club programs, events, lessons, and member activities.

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
Built foundational relationships with local churches.
Communicated with users about the websites pain points and wishlist items.
Offered feature recommendations to the development team based on user feedback.

positions.title: Web Developer and Server Administrator
positions.description:
Developed new features and functionality in Drupal within an existing LAMP stack, using PHP, JavaScript, and MySQL. 
Diagnosed and resolved application, database, and server issues across production websites. 
Managed Linux web servers through SSH, performing configuration changes, deployments, updates, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Tested IoT related projects using Appium Testing Suite
Followed Testing Iteration and Documentation Procedures
Participated in Scrum Procedures and JIRA Tracking
positions.insights: Azure DevOps Services, Appium and +2 skills

positions.title: Team Member
positions.description:
• Assembled food
• Organized food prep.
• Performed miscellaneous tasks
• Assisted other stores
